intake_corrections: Parallel component methods extend NetGO 3.0; the four additions are not the complete ensemble.
LR-MEM concatenates representations then trains logistic-regression classifiers; it is not vector concatenation alone.
Learning-to-rank input includes a 20-dimensional species encoding.
Net-KNN predictions are filtered to 15 species.
InterProScan produces domain/family/motif features; ESM-1b produces sequence embeddings.
The primary writeup does not establish the precise pairwise objective or LambdaMART implementation claimed by the intake.

retrieval_primary_link.finding: Authors identify GORetriever as a CAFA5 winning component and link their repository; not the full ensemble.

source_findings: GORetriever repository is inference-oriented; its complete tree has no license-named file and API license is null.
GOAlpha is MIT-licensed but explicitly a CAFA6 successor.
GOAlpha active orchestration uses ESM2/SVM, not the CAFA5 ESM-1b/LR choice.
GOAlpha orchestration loads precomputed retrieval and GOXML scores; it does not execute both components end to end.
GOAlpha ltr.py loads an external XGBoost model; it does not establish CAFA5 ranker training.
GOAlpha GOXML documentation specifies a later BioLinkBERT configuration. No equivalence to CAFA5 is established.
next_steps: Resolve original CAFA5 ensemble training/configuration and component reuse licenses.
The MIT successor may support separately scoped component work after full review, but cannot substitute for complete CAFA5 coverage.
confidentiality: Only public software/docs/license files inspected and pinned. No sequence records, literature corpora, structures, model weights, task data or archives downloaded.
